landing.heroDesc: Yakha imikhuba yetimali lenhle ngekuhlela ibhajethi ngekuhlakanipha, kuhlela kulondvoloza, kanye nekucondziswa ngqo — konkhe kuhlelelwe simo setimali saseNingizimu Afrika.

features.aiCoachDesc: Seluleko lesicondvisiwe ngqo lelisetjentiswa yi-AI leyati ibhajethi yakho, imigomo yekulondvoloza, nemikhuba yekusetjentiswa kwemali
features.smartBudgetDesc: Landzela kusetjentiswa kwemali ngesigaba ngemabha lachubeka ngqo netecwayiso tekusetjentisa kakhulu
features.savingsGoalsDesc: Beka imigomo lenemacala ekugcina utfole tincomo letihlakanipha tekufinyelela kuyo ngekushesha
features.healthScoreDesc: Sikali lesiguqukako lesibonisa imali lengenako, kusetjentiswa, silinganiso sekulondvoloza, nemphilo yetikweleti

steps.step1Desc: Faka imali lengenako yakho wente tigaba tekusetjentiswa kwemali
steps.step2Desc: Bhala tindleko ubeke imigomo yekulondvoloza lenemacala ekugcina
steps.step3Desc: Buta umceceshi wakho we-AI seluleko setimali lesicondvisiwe ngqo

landing.testimonial: I-MaliMind ingisite kulondvoloza u-R15,000 wesikwama sami setimo letiphuthumako ngetinyanga letine nje. Umceceshi we-AI ungigcina nginemtfwalo ngendlela lengazange yenteke nge-app.

savings.title: Imigomo Yekulondvoloza
savings.noGoals: Awukabi nemigomo yekulondvoloza. Enta wakho wekucala!

coach.title: Umceceshi Wetimali we-AI
coach.greeting: Sawubona! Ngingumceceshi wakho wetimali we-MaliMind AI. Ngiyakwati kubona ibhajethi yakho, imigomo yekulondvoloza, nesikali semphilo yetimali — ngaloko seluleko sami sicondvisiwe esimeni sakho. Ufuna kusitwa ngani lamuhla?
coach.limitReached: Ufikile emkhawulweni wemilayeto yamahhala yonkhe emalanga. Kuphuphurela ku-Pro kutfola kuceceshwa lokunganamkhawulo!
coach.error: Uxolo, angikwatanga kuphendvula loko. Linga futsi.
